passage:
Renewable energy has become increasingly important as countries attempt to reduce pollution and dependence on fossil fuels. Renewable energy sources include solar power, wind energy, hydroelectric power, and geothermal energy. Unlike fossil fuels, these energy sources can naturally replenish over time and generally produce fewer harmful emissions.

Solar energy is one of the fastest-growing renewable energy industries in the world. Advances in technology have made solar panels more efficient and affordable for businesses and homeowners. Wind farms have also expanded rapidly in many countries, providing electricity to millions of people.

Despite these advantages, renewable energy systems still face several challenges. Building renewable energy infrastructure can require large financial investments, and some energy sources depend heavily on weather conditions. However, environmental experts argue that renewable energy is essential for reducing climate change and creating a more sustainable future.
